reason: I'm not handing Google sign-in and my work chats to a bot I've never heard of, run by people I can't name. And honestly, I could wire up n8n with an OCR step and a Google Sheet myself over a weekend.
objection: Access. The bot sits in the group chats where my staff talk about money, and it wants my Google account too. If it gets breached or the company disappears, my financial records and conversations go with it.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, narrow permission scope (access only to the one sheet and folder it creates, not my whole Drive), a named company with a published data policy, and a real promise not to store chat messages that aren't receipts. Then I'd try it on the free 40 documents.
